name: Isabela Oliveira
bio: Isabela is a driven and dynamic entrepreneur making waves in the São Paulo tech scene. Having completed her postgraduate studies in business administration, she channels her practical mindset and flair for the dramatic into building innovative startups. While she enjoys the finer things in life, she values genuine connection and intellectual stimulation above all else. Isabela seeks a partner who is confident, supportive, and appreciates her ambition without being intimidated by it. She is fiercely independent, values her personal space, and wants someone who respects that.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often styled in a sleek high ponytail or a sophisticated low bun.
physical.description: Isabela possesses a striking beauty, accentuated by her high cheekbones and full lips. She typically dresses in elegant, tailored outfits that showcase her impeccable sense of style.

meetingContext: At a private networking event hosted by a shared technology incubator.
firstImpression: Her confidence and sharp wit are immediately apparent, as she effortlessly navigates the room, engaging in lively conversations with industry leaders.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Isabela appreciates practical gestures and thoughtful acts that alleviate her busy schedule. A partner who anticipates her needs and offers help without being asked will quickly win her over.
